name: Tech Mahindra
description: Targeted placement preparation for Tech Mahindra covering Tech Mahindra Tech Test patterns and enterprise technical standards.
common_roles: Java Developer, Python Developer, Data Analyst, Software Engineer
hiring_rounds: Round 1: Aptitude & English -> Round 2: Tech Test -> Round 3: Tech Interview -> HR
aptitude_pattern: Numerical Ability (20 Qs) + Logical (20 Qs) + English Conversational Test
coding_pattern: 2 Coding challenges on Matrix diagonal traversal, String reverse preserving special characters, Dutch National Flag - 45 mins
technical_focus: 5G Service-Based Architecture, Socket programming (TCP/UDP), Telecom mediation pipelines, MQTT protocol for IoT
hr_tips: Align with 'Rise' philosophy: Accepting no limits, Alternative thinking, Driving positive change
recommended_skills: Java, Python, Networking (TCP/IP), SQL, Telecom 5G, Linux, Docker

questions.question: In Tech Mahindra Tech Test Quantitative: A telecom fiber-optic link transmits data packets at 100 Mbps. If a packet is 1,250 bytes long, how many packets can be transmitted across the link in 1 second?
questions.explanation: 100 Mbps = 100,000,000 bits/sec. Packet size in bits = 1,250 bytes * 8 = 10,000 bits. Packets per second = 100,000,000 / 10,000 = 10,000 packets/sec.

questions.question: A telecommunication mobile tower's subscriber call drop rate drops by 20% in month 1 and by another 15% in month 2. What is the net percentage reduction in call drops over the two months?

In Tech Mahindra Reasoning: In a 5G network cell, Base Station X is 12 km North of Base Station Y, and Base Station Z is 9 km East of Base Station Y. What is the straight-line distance between Station X and Station Z?
questions.explanation: Triangle XYZ forms a right-angled triangle with legs 12 km and 9 km. By Pythagorean theorem: Distance = sqrt(12^2 + 9^2) = sqrt(144 + 81) = sqrt(225) = 15 km.

questions.question: Find the next number in the Tech Mahindra series: 5, 11, 23, 47, 95, ___?
In Tech Mahindra Conversational English: Choose the sentence that is grammatically error-free:
options: The network administrator has resolved the routing latency issue.
The network administrator have resolved the routing latency issue.
The network administrator has resolve the routing latency issue.
The network administrator are resolving the routing latency issue.
questions.correct_answer: The network administrator has resolved the routing latency issue.
questions.explanation: Singular subject ('administrator') requires singular auxiliary verb 'has' and past participle 'resolved'.

questions.question: Two telecom engineers A and B can install a microwave antenna in 6 hours and 12 hours respectively. How long will they take working together?
questions.explanation: Combined rate = 1/6 + 1/12 = (2 + 1)/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 antenna/hour. Total time = 4.0 hours.

questions.question: A cellular service provider sells a data plan for Rs. 420 making a profit of 20%. What was the cost of delivery for the data plan?
In how many ways can 4 5G radio frequencies be allocated to 4 cellular sectors with exactly one frequency per sector?
questions.explanation: Permutations of 4 distinct frequencies = 4! = 4 * 3 * 2 * 1 = 24 ways.

questions.question: If 'NETWORK' is coded as 'MDSVNQJ' in a telecom cipher, what is the code for 'ROUTER'?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted backward by -1: R->Q, O->N, U->T, T->S (or U->T), E->D, R->Q.

questions.question: A vehicle traveling at 54 km/h crosses a 180-meter long telecom transmission line span in how many seconds?
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Time = Distance / Speed = 180 / 15 = 12 seconds.

questions.question: In Tech Mahindra Non-Verbal Logic: A clock is rotated 90 degrees clockwise. If the hour hand was pointing at 3 o'clock initially, what number on the face does it point to now?
questions.explanation: 90 degrees clockwise from 3 o'clock (horizontal right) points vertically downward to 6 o'clock.

questions.question: What is the average of the first 10 multiples of 4?
A wireless router signal strength decays exponentially according to S(d) = S0 * 2^(-d/5), where d is distance in meters. At what distance d will signal strength drop to 25% of S0?
In a team of 30 telecom engineers, 18 know 5G protocol stacks and 16 know Cloud NFV. If 4 know neither, how many engineers know BOTH 5G and NFV?
questions.explanation: Total knowing at least one = 30 - 4 = 26. By inclusion-exclusion: 18 + 16 - Both = 26 => Both = 34 - 26 = 8 engineers.

questions.question: In Tech Mahindra Syllogisms: Statements: 1. All cell towers are transmitters. 2. No transmitter is a receiver. Conclusion I: No cell tower is a receiver. Conclusion II: Some transmitters are cell towers.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
questions.correct_answer: Both conclusions I and II follow
questions.explanation: All cell towers are transmitters, and no transmitter is a receiver; therefore no cell tower is a receiver (I). Conversion of Statement 1 yields II. Both follow.

questions.question: Given a string s containing alphanumeric characters and special characters (like symbols, punctuation), reverse only the alphabetic characters while keeping all special characters in their original positions.
questions.explanation: Tech Mahindra classic: Two pointers (left and right). Advance left if not letter, advance right if not letter. When both are letters, swap and advance both in O(N).

extra.title: Reverse String Preserving Special Characters

questions.question: Given a square matrix mat, return the sum of the matrix diagonals. Only include the sum of all the elements on the primary diagonal and all the elements on the secondary diagonal that are not part of the primary diagonal.
questions.explanation: Single loop from 0 to n-1: add mat[i][i] and mat[i][n-1-i]. If n is odd, subtract center element mat[n/2][n/2] in O(N).

extra.title: Matrix Diagonal Sum (Network Mesh Grid)

questions.question: Compute the Nth Fibonacci number in O(N) time and O(1) space using iterative memoization.
questions.explanation: Maintain two variables prev1 and prev2 rolling through loop up to n in O(N) time and O(1) space.

extra.title: Fibonacci Series Memoization (Telecom Backoff)

questions.question: Given an array nums with n objects colored red, white, or blue (represented by 0, 1, and 2), sort them in-place so that objects of the same color are adjacent.
questions.explanation: Three-pointer Dutch National Flag algorithm: low, mid, high pointers sorting in-place in a single O(N) pass.

extra.title: Sort Array of 0s, 1s, and 2s (Dutch National Flag)

questions.question: Given an unsorted array of integers nums, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence in O(N) runtime.
questions.explanation: Insert all numbers into a HashSet. Only start counting sequence from numbers where num - 1 is NOT in set, achieving O(N) overall.

extra.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence in Unsorted Array

questions.question: Write an efficient algorithm that searches for a target value in an m x n integer matrix. Integers in each row are sorted from left to right, and the first integer of each row is greater than the last integer of the previous row.
questions.explanation: Treat the 2D matrix as a flat 1D sorted array of size M*N and execute standard binary search with row = mid / n, col = mid % n in O(log(MN)).

extra.title: Search in 2D Matrix (Row and Column Sorted)

questions.question: Given a string s, return true if the s can be palindrome after deleting at most one character from it.
questions.explanation: Two pointers from ends. If mismatch at (i, j), check if substring s[i+1..j] OR s[i..j-1] is a valid palindrome in O(N).

extra.title: Valid Palindrome II (At Most One Deletion)

questions.question: Inversion Count for an array indicates how far (or close) the array is from being sorted. If the array is already sorted, then inversion count is 0. If sorted in reverse order, inversion count is maximum. Return total inversion count in O(N log N).
questions.explanation: Modified Merge Sort: During merge step, whenever element from right half is smaller than left half, all remaining elements in left half form inversions.

extra.title: Count Inversions in an Array

questions.question: Explain 5G Network Slicing and Service-Based Architecture (SBA). How do Network Functions (AMF, SMF, UPF) communicate over HTTP/2 REST APIs at Tech Mahindra?
questions.explanation: SBA replaces point-to-point telecom interfaces with a service-based bus. Network Functions register with NRF (Network Repository Function) and communicate via HTTP/2 JSON REST APIs. Network Slicing creates virtualized end-to-end networks customized for specific SLAs (eMBB, URLLC, mMTC).

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: What is Network Functions Virtualization (NFV) and Software-Defined Networking (SDN)? How do virtualized network functions (VNFs) run on cloud-native Kubernetes (CNFs)?
questions.explanation: NFV decouples network software (firewalls, routers, EPC) from proprietary hardware. SDN separates control plane from data forwarding plane. CNFs package network functions into lightweight container pods managed by Kubernetes.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: Explain Telecom OSS (Operations Support Systems) and BSS (Business Support Systems) architectures and how mediation engines process millions of Call Detail Records (CDRs).
questions.explanation: BSS handles customer billing, subscriptions, and revenue management. OSS manages network inventory, service provisioning, and fault management. Mediation engines collect raw network CDRs, decode binary formats (ASN.1), and feed rated records to billing engines.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: How does Socket Programming work in Java / Python using ServerSocket and Socket for low-latency TCP communication in telecommunications?
questions.explanation: ServerSocket binds to an IP and port, listening with accept() which blocks until a client connects, returning a dedicated Socket instance with InputStream and OutputStream for bidirectional TCP communication.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: Explain the MQTT protocol: Publish-Subscribe architecture, Topic Hierarchies (wildcards + and #), and Quality of Service (QoS 0, 1, 2) levels for smart IoT devices.
questions.explanation: MQTT is a lightweight binary protocol. QoS 0 sends at most once (no ack); QoS 1 delivers at least once (PUBACK); QoS 2 guarantees exactly once via four-step handshake (PUBREC, PUBREL, PUBCOMP).

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: How do you process real-time telecommunication event streams using Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, and sliding time-windows for fraud detection?
questions.explanation: CDR events stream into Kafka topics partitioned by subscriber IMSI. Kafka Streams computes tumbling/sliding time-window aggregations (e.g. flagging subscribers placing calls from two different cities within 5 minutes).

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: Explain OSI 7-Layer Networking Model versus TCP/IP Model and how data packets are encapsulated and decapsulated as they traverse layers.
questions.explanation: Application -> Transport (adds TCP port header) -> Network (adds IP header) -> Data Link (adds MAC frame header/trailer) -> Physical (bits). Decapsulation strips headers in reverse at destination.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: How does Redis in-memory caching accelerate subscriber session profile lookups in high-concurrency telecom authorization gateways?
questions.explanation: Redis stores subscriber policy profiles (data balance, active subscriptions) in RAM with sub-millisecond retrieval. Key eviction (TTL) and LRU policies ensure memory remains within provisioned limits.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: Explain Java Multithreading: ThreadPoolExecutor parameters (corePoolSize, maximumPoolSize, keepAliveTime, workQueue, RejectedExecutionHandler).
questions.explanation: Tasks run on core threads; additional tasks enqueue in workQueue; if queue fills, pool scales up to maximumPoolSize; if max threads saturated, RejectedExecutionHandler (AbortPolicy, CallerRunsPolicy) handles overflow.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: How do you optimize SQL queries on massive telecommunication databases storing billions of call transaction records?
questions.explanation: Table partitioning by date (range partitioning); creating composite indexes on (subscriber_id, timestamp); leveraging parallel query execution; purging historical records into cold cloud storage.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: Explain the difference between TCP and UDP protocols. In what telecom applications would an architect strictly select UDP over TCP?
questions.explanation: TCP is connection-oriented, reliable, and ordered with congestion control. UDP is connectionless and lightweight without retransmissions, ideal for latency-critical real-time media streaming (VoIP, video calls) where lost packets are preferable to latency jitter.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: How does Docker containerization package telecom microservices, and how does Docker Host networking mode bypass bridge latency for high-speed packet processing?
questions.explanation: Docker host networking mode (--net=host) bypasses network namespace isolation and Docker bridge NAT routing, binding container sockets directly to the host network interfaces for zero packet forwarding overhead.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: Explain RESTful API design principles with Spring Boot: HTTP Status Codes (200, 201, 204, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500) and HATEOAS.
questions.explanation: 200 OK, 201 Created (resource creation), 204 No Content (delete), 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 500 Internal Error. HATEOAS enriches responses with hypermedia navigation links.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: What is a Linux Packet Sniffer (tcpdump / Wireshark), and how do you capture and analyze SIP / diameter telecom signaling packets?
questions.explanation: tcpdump captures raw packets matching pcap filters (e.g. 'tcp port 5060' for SIP). Wireshark dissects packet headers displaying call flow sequence diagrams, invite requests, and error codes (486 Busy Here).

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: Explain the difference between Synchronous Blocking I/O and Asynchronous Reactive Programming with Spring WebFlux in telecom API gateways.
questions.explanation: Blocking I/O dedicates one thread per request, saturating thread pools under high concurrency. Spring WebFlux uses Project Reactor and Netty event loops to handle thousands of concurrent requests with a small fixed number of threads.

extra.company_focus: Rise philosophy, telecom 5G network slicing, NFV/SDN, OSS/BSS digital billing systems, Java/Python socket programming

questions.question: How is Artificial Intelligence applied at Tech Mahindra to automate 5G network traffic prediction and dynamic radio slice optimization?
questions.explanation: Discuss: Collecting real-time cell tower KPI telemetry, training time-series models (LSTM, Prophet) to forecast peak congestion, and dynamically reallocating bandwidth slices.

questions.question: Explain how Generative AI conversational assistants are deployed in telecom customer care to handle complex billing and eSIM activation queries.
questions.explanation: Architecture: RAG over telecom tariff rules and plan manuals, intent classification, calling BSS APIs for balance queries, and human escalation for disputed charges.

extra.ai_rubric: Tech Mahindra Telecom Customer Care AI

questions.question: Describe how computer vision and AI drones automate cell tower structural inspections and antenna alignment verification at Tech Mahindra.
questions.explanation: Detail: Drone cameras capture high-resolution imagery; YOLO object detection identifies rust, loose cables, and misaligned microwave dishes; automated work orders dispatch to technicians.

questions.question: How do you implement an AI-powered automated code modernization pipeline for legacy telecom billing systems (C/C++ to Java/Go)?
questions.explanation: Explain: Parsing procedural C code into abstract syntax trees, prompting specialized LLMs with modern language idioms, generating automated regression test suites, and verifying outputs.

questions.question: What techniques mitigate hallucinations when LLMs generate automated network configuration scripts (CLI commands for Cisco/Juniper routers)?
questions.explanation: Discuss: Strict grammar-constrained decoding, validating generated commands against a simulated router CLI sandbox, and requiring senior network engineer sign-off.

questions.question: How do you design a real-time SIM-swap fraud detection pipeline using machine learning models integrated with telecom core network events?
questions.explanation: Detail: Correlating SIM replacement timestamps with subsequent high-value banking OTP requests, scoring anomaly probability in < 100ms, and alerting banks.

extra.ai_rubric: Tech Mahindra SIM Fraud Detection AI

questions.question: How do you optimize LLM inference performance on edge telecom servers (MEC - Multi-Access Edge Computing) near cell towers?
questions.explanation: Explain: Model quantization (INT4/INT8), local caching of standard telecom intent responses, and utilizing GPU-accelerated edge containers.

questions.question: Describe how Tech Mahindra ensures ethical AI and data privacy compliance when training models on subscriber call detail records (CDRs).
questions.explanation: Cover: Data anonymization, hashing IMSI and phone numbers, differential privacy noise injection, and strict role-based access control.

extra.ai_rubric: Tech Mahindra AI Data Privacy & Ethics

questions.question: How do you evaluate and monitor the accuracy of automated AI root-cause analysis engines across multi-vendor telecom network alarms?
questions.explanation: Discuss: F1-score comparison against historical network engineer incident resolutions, mean-time-to-repair (MTTR) reduction metrics, and human-in-the-loop validation.

questions.question: How does Tech Mahindra foster AI fluency across its engineering workforce through the TechM Techify and AI Academy initiatives?
questions.explanation: Discuss: Hands-on AI labs, 5G AI hackathons, prompt engineering certifications, and domain-specific generative AI masterclasses.

questions.question: Tech Mahindra is guided by the Mahindra 'Rise' philosophy: Accepting No Limits, Alternative Thinking, and Driving Positive Change. How have you lived these values?
questions.explanation: Provide a personal example showcasing pushing beyond conventional boundaries, creative problem solving, and making a positive impact on your project or community.

questions.question: Why do you specifically choose Tech Mahindra to build your software engineering career?
questions.explanation: Highlight: Tech Mahindra's global dominance in telecommunications and digital engineering, strong Mahindra Group ethical heritage, and collaborative culture.

questions.question: Tech Mahindra has major campuses across India (Pune Hinjewadi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Mumbai). Are you fully flexible with relocation and rotational shifts?
questions.explanation: Affirm: Complete willingness to relocate, readiness to support global telecom client project time zones, and adaptability to hybrid working models.

questions.question: Telecom and enterprise software projects often involve critical client deliverables. Tell me about a time you handled high pressure under strict deadlines.
questions.explanation: Use STAR: Outline the pressure, organized task prioritization, transparent communication with leads, and successful on-time delivery.

questions.question: Describe a time you demonstrated 'Alternative Thinking' by proposing a non-traditional technical solution that solved a stubborn software bug.
questions.explanation: Showcase: Creative out-of-the-box thinking, experimenting with prototypes, proving feasibility with benchmarks, and unblocking the project.

questions.question: How do you handle collaborating with a team member who is reluctant to adopt new agile software development practices?
questions.explanation: Emphasize: Empathy, patient communication, explaining the practical benefits of the new workflow, and helping them transition smoothly.

questions.question: Where do you see yourself progressing at Tech Mahindra over the next 3 to 5 years as an engineer?
questions.explanation: Connect: Growing from Associate Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer / Solution Lead, mastering 5G cloud networks, and mentoring new campus hires.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you received critical constructive feedback on your technical performance. How did you react and what changes did you make?
questions.explanation: Demonstrate: Professional humility, analyzing feedback constructively, adopting clean coding practices, and showing measurable improvement.

questions.question: What unique personal attributes or strengths set you apart from other candidates interviewing for Tech Mahindra today?
questions.explanation: Combine: Strong computer science fundamentals, passion for telecommunications and cloud innovation, proactive attitude, and alignment with Rise values.

questions.question: Do you have any questions for Tech Mahindra leadership regarding our project allocation, telecom innovation centers, or learning culture?
questions.explanation: Candidate asks about Tech Mahindra Makers Lab innovation hubs, 5G engineering labs, or career progression tracks.

questions.question: In Tech Mahindra Tech Test Quantitative: A telecom fiber-optic link transmits data packets at 100 Mbps. If a packet is 1,250 bytes long, how many packets can be transmitted across the link in 1 second? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: 100 Mbps = 100,000,000 bits/sec. Packet size in bits = 1,250 bytes * 8 = 10,000 bits. Packets per second = 100,000,000 / 10,000 = 10,000 packets/sec.

questions.question: A telecommunication mobile tower's subscriber call drop rate drops by 20% in month 1 and by another 15% in month 2. What is the net percentage reduction in call drops over the two months? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]

In Tech Mahindra Reasoning: In a 5G network cell, Base Station X is 12 km North of Base Station Y, and Base Station Z is 9 km East of Base Station Y. What is the straight-line distance between Station X and Station Z? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: Triangle XYZ forms a right-angled triangle with legs 12 km and 9 km. By Pythagorean theorem: Distance = sqrt(12^2 + 9^2) = sqrt(144 + 81) = sqrt(225) = 15 km.

questions.question: Find the next number in the Tech Mahindra series: 5, 11, 23, 47, 95, ___? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]

The network administrator have resolved the routing latency issue.
The network administrator has resolve the routing latency issue.
The network administrator are resolving the routing latency issue.

questions.explanation: Singular subject ('administrator') requires singular auxiliary verb 'has' and past participle 'resolved'.

questions.question: Two telecom engineers A and B can install a microwave antenna in 6 hours and 12 hours respectively. How long will they take working together? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: Combined rate = 1/6 + 1/12 = (2 + 1)/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 antenna/hour. Total time = 4.0 hours.

questions.question: A cellular service provider sells a data plan for Rs. 420 making a profit of 20%. What was the cost of delivery for the data plan? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
In how many ways can 4 5G radio frequencies be allocated to 4 cellular sectors with exactly one frequency per sector? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: Permutations of 4 distinct frequencies = 4! = 4 * 3 * 2 * 1 = 24 ways.

questions.question: If 'NETWORK' is coded as 'MDSVNQJ' in a telecom cipher, what is the code for 'ROUTER'? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted backward by -1: R->Q, O->N, U->T, T->S (or U->T), E->D, R->Q.

questions.question: A vehicle traveling at 54 km/h crosses a 180-meter long telecom transmission line span in how many seconds? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Time = Distance / Speed = 180 / 15 = 12 seconds.

questions.question: In Tech Mahindra Non-Verbal Logic: A clock is rotated 90 degrees clockwise. If the hour hand was pointing at 3 o'clock initially, what number on the face does it point to now? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: 90 degrees clockwise from 3 o'clock (horizontal right) points vertically downward to 6 o'clock.

questions.question: What is the average of the first 10 multiples of 4? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]

A wireless router signal strength decays exponentially according to S(d) = S0 * 2^(-d/5), where d is distance in meters. At what distance d will signal strength drop to 25% of S0? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
In a team of 30 telecom engineers, 18 know 5G protocol stacks and 16 know Cloud NFV. If 4 know neither, how many engineers know BOTH 5G and NFV? [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
questions.explanation: Total knowing at least one = 30 - 4 = 26. By inclusion-exclusion: 18 + 16 - Both = 26 => Both = 34 - 26 = 8 engineers.

questions.question: In Tech Mahindra Syllogisms: Statements: 1. All cell towers are transmitters. 2. No transmitter is a receiver. Conclusion I: No cell tower is a receiver. Conclusion II: Some transmitters are cell towers. [TECHMAHINDRA Version]
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
questions.correct_answer: Both conclusions I and II follow
questions.explanation: All cell towers are transmitters, and no transmitter is a receiver; therefore no cell tower is a receiver (I). Conversion of Statement 1 yields II. Both follow.

questions.question: Given a string s containing alphanumeric characters and special characters (like symbols, punctuation), reverse only the alphabetic characters while keeping all special characters in their original positions. [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #1]
questions.explanation: Tech Mahindra classic: Two pointers (left and right). Advance left if not letter, advance right if not letter. When both are letters, swap and advance both in O(N).

extra.title: Reverse String Preserving Special Characters

questions.question: Given a square matrix mat, return the sum of the matrix diagonals. Only include the sum of all the elements on the primary diagonal and all the elements on the secondary diagonal that are not part of the primary diagonal. [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #2]
questions.explanation: Single loop from 0 to n-1: add mat[i][i] and mat[i][n-1-i]. If n is odd, subtract center element mat[n/2][n/2] in O(N).

extra.title: Matrix Diagonal Sum (Network Mesh Grid)

questions.question: Compute the Nth Fibonacci number in O(N) time and O(1) space using iterative memoization. [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #3]
questions.explanation: Maintain two variables prev1 and prev2 rolling through loop up to n in O(N) time and O(1) space.

extra.title: Fibonacci Series Memoization (Telecom Backoff)

questions.question: Given an array nums with n objects colored red, white, or blue (represented by 0, 1, and 2), sort them in-place so that objects of the same color are adjacent. [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #4]
questions.explanation: Three-pointer Dutch National Flag algorithm: low, mid, high pointers sorting in-place in a single O(N) pass.

extra.title: Sort Array of 0s, 1s, and 2s (Dutch National Flag)

questions.question: Given an unsorted array of integers nums, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence in O(N) runtime. [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #5]
questions.explanation: Insert all numbers into a HashSet. Only start counting sequence from numbers where num - 1 is NOT in set, achieving O(N) overall.

extra.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence in Unsorted Array

questions.question: Write an efficient algorithm that searches for a target value in an m x n integer matrix. Integers in each row are sorted from left to right, and the first integer of each row is greater than the last integer of the previous row. [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #6]
questions.explanation: Treat the 2D matrix as a flat 1D sorted array of size M*N and execute standard binary search with row = mid / n, col = mid % n in O(log(MN)).

extra.title: Search in 2D Matrix (Row and Column Sorted)

questions.question: Given a string s, return true if the s can be palindrome after deleting at most one character from it. [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #7]
questions.explanation: Two pointers from ends. If mismatch at (i, j), check if substring s[i+1..j] OR s[i..j-1] is a valid palindrome in O(N).

extra.title: Valid Palindrome II (At Most One Deletion)

questions.question: Inversion Count for an array indicates how far (or close) the array is from being sorted. If the array is already sorted, then inversion count is 0. If sorted in reverse order, inversion count is maximum. Return total inversion count in O(N log N). [TECHMAHINDRA Problem #8]
questions.explanation: Modified Merge Sort: During merge step, whenever element from right half is smaller than left half, all remaining elements in left half form inversions.

extra.title: Count Inversions in an Array

questions.question: What techniques mitigate hallucinations when LLMs generate automated network configuration scripts (CLI commands for Cisco/Juniper routers)? [TECHMAHINDRA AI Round]
questions.explanation: Discuss: Strict grammar-constrained decoding, validating generated commands against a simulated router CLI sandbox, and requiring senior network engineer sign-off.

questions.question: How do you design a real-time SIM-swap fraud detection pipeline using machine learning models integrated with telecom core network events? [TECHMAHINDRA AI Round]
questions.explanation: Detail: Correlating SIM replacement timestamps with subsequent high-value banking OTP requests, scoring anomaly probability in < 100ms, and alerting banks.

extra.ai_rubric: Tech Mahindra SIM Fraud Detection AI

questions.question: How do you optimize LLM inference performance on edge telecom servers (MEC - Multi-Access Edge Computing) near cell towers? [TECHMAHINDRA AI Round]
questions.explanation: Explain: Model quantization (INT4/INT8), local caching of standard telecom intent responses, and utilizing GPU-accelerated edge containers.

questions.question: Describe how Tech Mahindra ensures ethical AI and data privacy compliance when training models on subscriber call detail records (CDRs). [TECHMAHINDRA AI Round]
questions.explanation: Cover: Data anonymization, hashing IMSI and phone numbers, differential privacy noise injection, and strict role-based access control.

extra.ai_rubric: Tech Mahindra AI Data Privacy & Ethics

questions.question: How do you evaluate and monitor the accuracy of automated AI root-cause analysis engines across multi-vendor telecom network alarms? [TECHMAHINDRA AI Round]
questions.explanation: Discuss: F1-score comparison against historical network engineer incident resolutions, mean-time-to-repair (MTTR) reduction metrics, and human-in-the-loop validation.

questions.question: How does Tech Mahindra foster AI fluency across its engineering workforce through the TechM Techify and AI Academy initiatives? [TECHMAHINDRA AI Round]
questions.explanation: Discuss: Hands-on AI labs, 5G AI hackathons, prompt engineering certifications, and domain-specific generative AI masterclasses.
